title: Two Buttons, One Target: Fewest Presses | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
A calculator with only two keys, +1 and ×2. Can you get from 3 to 90 in the fewest presses? Vantee shows two ways: work backwards from the target, and plan the doubles to prove nothing is shorter.

Then try the same trick on a bigger target of 100.
